subject: IAM evidence workplan, SCIM delta & SAML assertion samples
messages:
From: Alex Torres <alex.torres@novamed.com>
To: hannah_schmitt@redwoodinference.com
Cc: security@novamed.com
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SOC2 intake: SCIM delta + SAML assertion samples (Q2)

Hi Hannah,

We're starting our SOC 2 scoping for Q2 and need a short set of IAM artifacts to close a few control points. Can you help by delivering the following by end of next week (Mon 7/5)?

- A SCIM delta export for the period 2026-06-01 to 2026-06-30 (all add/modify/delete events).
- Representative SAML assertion samples for 3 user login flows (federated SSO, IdP-initiated, SP-initiated) with timestamps and assertion IDs.
- A snapshot of privileged role owners and their last attestation date (RBAC/least-privilege evidence).

If you can provide an initial delivery and a short runbook explaining redaction rules (we need hashed service account IDs, not plaintext), that would be ideal. Also let us know if you need a scope clarification (production only vs staging + production).

Thanks — we can route follow-ups to security@novamed.com.

Best,
Alex Torres
Senior IT Auditor, NovaMed Health
--
Alex Torres | alex.torres@novamed.com | +1 415-555-0198

From: hannah_schmitt@redwoodinference.com
To: Alex Torres <alex.torres@novamed.com>
Cc: sean_gallagher@redwoodinference.com, kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SOC2 intake: SCIM delta + SAML assertion samples (Q2)

Hi Alex — thanks for the clear ask. We can deliver those items; below is our proposed workplan and owners.

Scope check (please confirm): production tenants only (no staging) unless you tell us otherwise.

Planned deliverables (initial drop by Mon 7/5):
- scim_delta_20260601-20260630.csv (redacted service account IDs, retain event type/timestamp/actor) — owner: Sean
- saml_assertion_samples.txt (3 assertions with headers + signed assertion stub) — owner: Kimberly
- role_owners_snapshot.xlsx (RBAC owner mapping, role description, last attestation) — owner: Hannah
- short runbook.md (redaction rules, description of how SCIM deltas are extracted) — owner: Hannah

We've opened a tracker: JIRA-SEC-8423 and a shared Drive folder (link below) for delivery. Can you confirm production-only and whether you want CSV or NDJSON for the SCIM delta? We default to CSV for easier review but can provide both.

Attachment stubs: scim_delta_20260601-20260630.csv (will be redacted), saml_assertion_samples.txt, role_owners_snapshot.xlsx.

Action items:
- Alex: confirm scope (production vs prod+staging) and preferred SCIM format
- NovaMed security: confirm redaction acceptance for hashed service accounts

We'll aim to timestamp all artifacts and include an items-level index for your auditors.

Thanks,
Hannah Schmitt
Manager, Security Compliance | Redwood Inference
hannah_schmitt@redwoodinference.com
--
Redwood Inference — production-first inference platform

From: sean_gallagher@redwoodinference.com
To: hannah_schmitt@redwoodinference.com
Cc: kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com, Alex Torres <alex.torres@novamed.com>
Date: Wed, 01 Jul 2026 08:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SOC2 intake: SCIM delta + SAML assertion samples (Q2)

Hannah — following up with an initial artifact drop. Uploading the following to the shared Drive folder now (stubs attached in email):

- scim_delta_20260601-20260630.csv (sample rows, service_account_id hashed with SHA256, actor and timestamp preserved)
- saml_assertion_samples.txt (3 assertions: idp-initiated, sp-initiated, AEAD-federation example; assertion bodies have PII redacted)

Notes on redaction and verification:
- Service accounts are hashed and a mapping file is retained internally for incident response only (we do not include that mapping in standard deliveries).
- For the SAML assertions we include original assertion IDs and timestamps, but name identifiers are pseudonymized when the account is a non-human service principal.
- We can provide an HMAC-signed index file that proves integrity of delivered rows without exposing raw identifiers.

Quoted from Hannah's plan: "Can you confirm production-only and whether you want CSV or NDJSON for the SCIM delta?" — we defaulted to CSV for this drop.

Attachments: scim_delta_20260601-20260630.csv (stub), saml_assertion_samples.txt (stub)

Sean Gallagher
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
sean_gallagher@redwoodinference.com

From: Alex Torres <alex.torres@novamed.com>
To: hannah_schmitt@redwoodinference.com
Cc: security@novamed.com, sean_gallagher@redwoodinference.com
Date: Fri, 02 Jul 2026 11:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SOC2 intake: SCIM delta + SAML assertion samples (Q2)

Hannah / Sean — thanks for the rapid turnaround, I received the Drive upload and the sample attachments. The redaction approach sounds acceptable to our audit team.

One additional ask: could you include a 48-hour extract of admin session logs (time-limited) for June 29–30 (just the admin session start/stop and admin user identifier, hashed) so we can correlate assertion times to privileged console activity? If you can drop that as an addendum into JIRA-SEC-8423 by EOD Mon 7/5, we should be able to close the related SOC control.

We plan to review and revert with any clarifying questions by 7/8. Thanks again — appreciate the thorough runbook.

Best,
Alex Torres
Senior IT Auditor, NovaMed Health
